title: Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero W / Zero 2 W, Radxa ZERO 3W / 3E
notes: 65 x 30 mm, holes 58 x 23 mm, 3.5 mm from the edges (official Zero W and Zero 2 W mechanical drawings; the Zero has the same holes). The official drawings and 3D models of the Radxa ZERO 3W and 3E have the same outline and holes.
l = 0 is the microSD end, s = 0 the edge with the mini HDMI and micro USB ports. The GPIO-header edge (s = S) faces the back plate, the ports face out.
The holes are symmetric both ways, so one set fits either way round. The openings at both ends are the microSD notch (15 mm deep); all openings keep 2.5 mm from the holes.
microSD centred 16.9 mm from the port edge (official Zero W drawing).
The ZERO 3E's pads under the holes are 0.02 mm proud of its PCB, hence its underside at -1.62.
